objective: Expose the already read-only progression hierarchy player projection through the canonical /api/v1/snapshot without changing ledger authority, action gates, rewards, quest lifecycle or player state.

roles_before.artifact: Neon system_events remains the single mutable owner of derived RPG state.
/api/v1/snapshot projects event-ledger state through buildSnapshot plus calibration.
progressionPlayerView already computes a read-only Boss/Arc/rank-gate projection from verified events.
/api/v1/actions remains the only HTTP mutation route and store.applyAction remains the canonical action gate.
Recorded base SHA reconstructs the pre-integration snapshot.

role_dispositions.destination: No new persistence; progression_hierarchy is derived on read from the same event list.
Existing snapshot fields remain unchanged; one additive progression_hierarchy field is appended.
Reuse progressionPlayerView unchanged; it remains read_only with zero reward delta and no action.
No action route, supported action or mutation semantics change.
Base SHA remains the exact rollback point.

capability_probes.assertion: Existing calibrated snapshot fields remain available and unchanged.
Reading progression_hierarchy cannot create events, grant rewards, unlock rank or authorize an action.
Existing /api/v1/actions authority and supported mutation semantics remain unchanged.
Recorded base SHA restores the exact prior snapshot behavior.

tests.expected: Projection remains evidence-gated, read-only and reward-neutral.
